name: shopping-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog, find verified deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap-Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.5.1 searches Shopify Global Catalog, renders verified product cards, queries a configured verified Deals API for Coupon and Cashback evidence, and persists identity-bound price, promotion, inventory, and restock Watch rules for Codex Automation. Product Watch creation requires a generation/model/GTIN and explicit condition. Without approved data or affiliate relationships it fails closed and uses canonical merchant links. User-authorized Chrome remains a bounded one-time fallback, never an automated Watch source.
defaultPrompt: Use search_shopify_products, find_coupons, or create_watch plus Codex Automation. Never launch MCP.
